# Psalm 76 — Disagreement Log
**Generated by:** SOPHIA | **Threshold:** <70% word overlap

---

## 76:2 (overlap: 0%)

- **EMET:** And-was in-Salem his-booth, and-his-den in-Zion.
- **LOGOS:** His abode has been established in Salem, his dwelling place in Zion.
- **PNEUMA:** He set up his tent in Jerusalem and made Zion his home.

**SOPHIA ruling:** LOGOS reading adopted for consensus. EMET preserves source-language structure; PNEUMA captures interpretive meaning. All three contribute valid perspectives.

- **EMET:** Were-plundered the-stout-of-heart, they-slept their-sleep, and-not found all the-men-of might their-hands.
